clips.title: The story
paras: Cleansing the Eye is an Alliance quest that sends adventurers from the murky Wetlands south to the human capital of Stormwind. After recovering the cursed orb known as the Eye of Paleth, travelers must seek the aid of Archbishop Benedictus to purge its lingering taint.

The Eye of Paleth recovered from the marshlands does not shine with holy clarity. Instead, it is steeped in an unsettling shadow, bearing the residual sorrow and trauma of the terrible tragedy that unfolded where it was lost. The dwarf Glorin Steelbrow recognizes the power of the orb, but admits he lacks the divine craft to lift such a heavy affliction.

Because the Eyes of Paleth were originally fashioned by human priests of the Holy Light, only their highest order possesses the knowledge to undo the defilement. Glorin directs adventurers to journey to the kingdom of Stormwind and present the darkened orb to Archbishop Benedictus, leader of the Church of the Holy Light. Benedictus recognizes the immense danger of an unpurified relic and takes it upon himself to restore its sacred luminance.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I can't lift the curse from the Eye of Paleth. The Eyes were crafted by Human Priests, so you'll have to go to Stormwind to find someone who can help you. Speak with Archbishop Benedictus. He is head of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind. He can help.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What is that orb you have? It looks...soiled.

clips.title: Completion
paras: An Eye of Paleth. But this one has seen much sorrow...it must have been witness to a terrible, terrible tragedy.
Let me cleanse it, for the Eyes were created to shine bright, and their powers can be quite dangerous if tainted like this one.
